name: read
description: Read Claude's or a taken tab as an outline: one line per element with a short ref; long parts fold. ref: that part unfolded; full: nothing folded or cut; find (with role): matching lines; until: wait up to timeout_ms for text to appear or go; tabs: up to 5 tabs; cursor: the next page. Returns per tab its url, title, outline and typed_fields, or its error. Effect: read.

name: tabs
description: List every tab by window, Claude's group indented: number, whose (claude, his, taken), marks (* showing, pinned, sound, muted, asleep, popup, no: never readable, look: read-only site), quoted title, short address. Returns seen: name one of his tabs together with it. Popup windows stay in place. Their opener shows POP on the pinned toolbar button; its popup lists each controlled popup with its own Stop. Stop ends control without closing or reloading it. Effect: read.

name: open
description: Open a new Claude tab at url, at the address a tab shows (one of his: with the list's seen), or behind a link's or library entry's ref; a link whose click would ask refuses: click it with chrome_do. Waits until the page loaded or until is met (timeout_ms), then returns its outline (max). Effect: change.

name: go
description: Navigate a Claude or taken tab to url, or back, forward or reload; waits and returns like chrome_open. A taken tab gets its guarded reload first. Every direction and an address report unsaved typing or playing media as reload_required until repeated with discard_unsaved=true. reload never reloads a form-loaded page. Effect: change.

name: do
description: Run 1 to 20 steps in order in a Claude or taken tab, each by a read's ref: click; fill (text; line breaks are text); select (an option's value or label); check (checked); press (key); scroll (y pixels at ref); dialog (accept, text: the dialog last shown); wait (until, timeout_ms). Every ref is checked first. The list stops at a step that isn't done or unchanged, at a page change it didn't make and after 12 s; not_run counts steps that never ran: send them again. An asking step stops it: pass its prepared entry unchanged to chrome_submit. Returns each outcome with its operation_id, stale with the element now, popups opened, and what changed or a new page's outline (max). The first input in a taken tab or a popup reloads it once for the guard, staling refs; a form-loaded (non-GET) page refuses that reload: open its address fresh. A form holding a (filled, not read) field refuses its send, discard_unsaved too: chrome_go to=reload, then read. Effect: change.

name: show
description: Bring a tab and its window to the front, for the owner to look, sign in or answer a dialog. Changes no page. Effect: change.

name: close
description: Close Claude's own tabs, dropping their prepared work; a taken tab (release it) or his stays. Unsaved typing or playing media is reported first; discard_unsaved=true closes anyway, one tab per call. Returns closed and kept with reasons. Effect: change.

name: take
description: Take one of his tabs (with the list's seen) into Claude's group; taking or reading keeps its page. Returns reload_due, typed_fields and what the due reload would lose. The first input in a taken tab or a popup reloads it once for the guard, staling refs; a form-loaded (non-GET) page refuses that reload: open its address fresh. reload=true does that reload now and returns the outline; it discards like discard_unsaved, so the same OK rule applies. Effect: change.

name: release
description: End control and drop prepared work without dispatch. A cleanup_pending result means native restoration is still waiting; the owner must close its dialog or, if needed, the tab. Effect: change.

name: library
description: Search downloads, bookmarks or history (kind) by text, paged by cursor. Each entry has a short address and a ref chrome_open opens. Changes nothing. Effect: read.

name: upload
description: Prepare uploading a caller-side immutable file snapshot (path) into the file field ref; it always asks, with path and hash in the approval, and never opens a home path in the service. If its first-input reload would lose work it refuses: reload first, then repeat. Effect: change.

name: prepare_read_typed_fields
description: Prepare a one-call read of text-capable inputs and textareas in unwatched documents. Returns the exact field-label question without values; pass its approval to read_typed_fields. Effect: change. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: read_typed_fields
description: Read the listed inputs and textareas once after the exact question is approved. Fields flagged as credential-like are excluded. The connection, frames, reader and exact field identities are bound; changes refuse and require a fresh question; ordinary reads retain filled/empty. Returns each field's label, ref and value as page text. Effect: read. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: submit
description: Run exactly the prepared operation after approval, with question first and unchanged. Rechecks bound page state, dispatches once; no automatic retries. Effect: send. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: submit_trusted
description: Run a prepared adapter kind only if the owner-only exact-site/account/parameters entry still allows it. No prompt; deleting, paying and WhatsApp messages always refuse. Effect: send. Pass the service-provided approval unchanged, including its first field question, operation_id and complete description; never write or amend the question yourself.

name: drop
description: Cancel only reserved work; its stopped page step stays stopped and no input is dispatched. Effect: change.

name: operation_status
description: Read committed stages and uncertainty. checked then dispatched, followed by what the page showed; nothing is replayed. Effect: read.

name: notices
description: Read every Chrome warning occurrence through bounded pages, including open checks after a storage failure. Acknowledgement and action outcome are separate. Effect: read.

name: notice_ack
description: Acknowledge one warning occurrence. Unresolved actions remain pending. Effect: change.
